title: 📡 SDO Service Update
text:
NASA SDO is currently experiencing data outages. ☀️

For the time being, Sunny is explicitly using NOAA GOES-19 SUVI for solar imagery while the NASA SDO website and its data services are unavailable.

Sunny will return to his normal mix of NASA SDO/AIA and NOAA SUVI imagery once SDO service is restored.
Clear skies and sunny days! ☀️
